sections.title: Form and flowers
sections.text: White campion is a hairy, short-lived perennial or biennial, with flowering stems reaching about 1 m. Its opposite leaves are lance-shaped; the white, deeply notched flowers are about 3 cm across. Male and female flowers are borne on separate plants.

sections.title: Fruit and relatives
sections.text: The inflated calyx encloses a capsule that opens at the top. Red campion (Silene dioica) is a close relative with pink-red flowers; the two can hybridize. The plate’s white flowers and inflated calyces fit white campion.

sections.title: Use and safety
sections.text: The sources consulted do not establish a food use for this species.
